intro: Honduras exports coffee, bananas, clothes and shrimp.

chapters.title: How it earns
text: Honduras is one of Central America's biggest coffee producers. Garment factories make clothes for US brands, and money from Hondurans abroad is very important.

chapters.title: Tourism
text: Diving in the Bay Islands attracts visitors.

keyTerms.meaning: A factory assembling goods for export.
